metrics.name: Standard Macro Recall@3
metrics.denominator: Unweighted mean of per-query recall using R_total,q

metrics.name: Corpus-Level Graded nDCG@3
metrics.idcg_scope: Best possible Top-3 ranking from all judged relevant corpus chunks for each query

metrics.name: Corpus-Level Binary nDCG@3
metrics.idcg_scope: Best possible Top-3 ranking from all judged relevant corpus chunks for each query

definitions.hit_rate_at_k: Mean over queries of 1 if at least one Top-K result has grade >= 1, else 0.
definitions.precision_at_k: Relevant retrieved results in Top-K divided by K.
definitions.macro_recall_at_k: Mean over queries of relevant retrieved Top-K chunks divided by R_total for that query.
definitions.micro_recall_at_k: Total relevant retrieved chunks across queries divided by total relevant corpus chunks across queries.
definitions.evidence_mrr_at_k: Mean reciprocal rank of the first result with grade >= 1.
definitions.direct_answer_rr_at_k: Mean reciprocal rank of the first result with grade == 2.
definitions.dcg: Sum of gain_i / log2(i + 1), ranks i starting at 1.
definitions.ndcg: DCG divided by IDCG under the stated corpus-level scope.

source_report: RAG Gold Dataset Final Metric Consistency Report (2026-11-13)
caveat: Values are preserved from the completed audit reports; not recalculated from a live retrieval run.
